scenes.stat_label: OUTPUT GAP BETWEEN EFFORT VS LEVERAGE
bullets: The right lever multiplies every hour 1,000x
scenes.narration: You cannot out-work someone who has better leverage than you. Working twice as long only doubles your output—until you hit burnout.

scenes.headline: Old Leverage Needed Someone's Permission
scenes.left_body: Labor & Capital: Needs investors, bosses, or payroll
scenes.right_body: Code & Media: Zero gatekeepers, zero marginal cost
scenes.narration: For centuries, wealth required permissioned leverage: hiring people or raising millions in capital. Both required someone else to say yes to you first.

scenes.headline: AI Turned Words Into Working Software
scenes.stat_subtext: 1 Video or 1 Script works while you sleep
scenes.narration: Code and media changed the rules. A video you publish tonight or an AI script you build on Sunday works for ten thousand people while you sleep—at zero extra cost.
